entities.summary: Alexander Cory Harris is an American former professional basketball player. He played eleven seasons in several European countries. Harris played collegiately for UC Santa Barbara where he was the 2008 Big West Conference co-Player of the Year. He currently is a P.E teacher at a school in Vallejo, California
